notes.title: Minor changes, but important.
notes.content:
Improved visibility of the bounce direction indicator. 
The algorithm calculating game progress has been changed. 
Thank you all for your comments and opinions.

notes.title: New language packs.

- German,
- French,
- Spanish,
- Russian,
- Czech,
